name: Take
author: Mark Steere (February 2024) / AGP port

labels.3: Side 3 (19 cells — the rule sheet's figures)

labels.standard: Take — clods (a stone always removes the clod)
labels.high: High Churn — tiles (only a seed removes the tile)

description: Take (Mark Steere, 2024) — a free-form Tanbo on a hexagonal board that starts completely filled with neutral brown clods. Place a stone of your colour: a seed (no friendly neighbour) may only go on a clod cell, replacing it; any other stone lands on a clod or bare cell and must touch exactly one friendly stone, so groups grow one cell at a time and never merge. A group that can no longer be grown is bounded — and after every placement EVERY bounded group of either colour, including the one you just played into, is swept off the board at once. Remove all enemy stones to win; wipe out your own while theirs survive and you lose. The High Churn variant covers the board in tiles instead: only seeds consume a tile, so fresh seeds keep coming and the board turns over and over.
